name: Credit Transfer Transaction 80
definition: Provide further details specific to the individual transaction(s) included in the message.

PaymentIdentification.name: Payment Identification
PaymentIdentification.definition: Set of elements used to reference a payment instruction.

PaymentTypeInformation.name: Payment Type Information
PaymentTypeInformation.definition: Set of elements used to further specify the type of transaction.

InterbankSettlementAmount.name: Interbank Settlement Amount
InterbankSettlementAmount.definition: Amount of money moved between the instructing agent and the instructed agent.

InterbankSettlementDate.name: Interbank Settlement Date
InterbankSettlementDate.definition: Date on which the amount of money ceases to be available to the agent that owes it and when the amount of money becomes available to the agent to which it is due.

SettlementPriority.name: Settlement Priority
SettlementPriority.definition: Indicator of the urgency or order of importance that the instructing party would like the instructed party to apply to the processing of the settlement instruction.

SettlementTimeIndication.name: Settlement Time Indication
SettlementTimeIndication.definition: Provides information on the occurred settlement time(s) of the payment transaction.

SettlementTimeRequest.name: Settlement Time Request
SettlementTimeRequest.definition: Provides information on the requested settlement time(s) of the payment instruction.

ExpiryDateTime.name: Expiry Date Time
ExpiryDateTime.definition: Date and time on which the payment should be expired if it has not settled.

PaymentSignature.name: Payment Signature
PaymentSignature.definition: Cryptographic key identifying terms agreed by agents within the payment chain pre-settlement. This key can also be used post-settlement to confirm the payment has been credited as intended.

PreviousInstructingAgent1.name: Previous Instructing Agent 1
PreviousInstructingAgent1.definition: Agent between the debtor's agent and the instructing agent. ||Usage: If more than one previous instructing agent is present, then PreviousInstructingAgent1 identifies the agent between the DebtorAgent and the PreviousInstructingAgent2.

PreviousInstructingAgent1Account.name: Previous Instructing Agent 1 Account
PreviousInstructingAgent1Account.definition: Unambiguous identification of the account of the previous instructing agent at its servicing agent in the payment chain.

PreviousInstructingAgent2.name: Previous Instructing Agent 2
PreviousInstructingAgent2.definition: Agent between the debtor's agent and the instructing agent. ||Usage: If more than two previous instructing agent are present, then PreviousInstructingAgent2 identifies the agent between the PreviousInstructingAgent1 and the PreviousInstructingAgent3.

PreviousInstructingAgent2Account.name: Previous Instructing Agent 2 Account
PreviousInstructingAgent2Account.definition: Unambiguous identification of the account of the previous instructing agent at its servicing agent in the payment chain.

PreviousInstructingAgent3.name: Previous Instructing Agent 3
PreviousInstructingAgent3.definition: Agent between the debtor's agent and the instructing agent. ||Usage: If PreviousInstructingAgent3 is present, then PreviousInstructingAgent3 identifies the agent between the PreviousInstructingAgent2 and the InstructingAgent.

PreviousInstructingAgent3Account.name: Previous Instructing Agent 3 Account
PreviousInstructingAgent3Account.definition: Unambiguous identification of the account of the previous instructing agent at its servicing agent in the payment chain.

InstructingAgent.name: Instructing Agent
InstructingAgent.definition: Agent that instructs the next party in the chain to carry out the (set of) instruction(s).

InstructedAgent.name: Instructed Agent
InstructedAgent.definition: Agent that is instructed by the previous party in the chain to carry out the (set of) instruction(s).

IntermediaryAgent1.name: Intermediary Agent 1
IntermediaryAgent1.definition: Agent between the debtor's agent and the creditor's agent.||Usage: If more than one intermediary agent is present, then IntermediaryAgent1 identifies the agent between the DebtorAgent and the IntermediaryAgent2.

IntermediaryAgent1Account.name: Intermediary Agent 1 Account
IntermediaryAgent1Account.definition: Unambiguous identification of the account of the intermediary agent 1 at its servicing agent in the payment chain.

IntermediaryAgent2.name: Intermediary Agent 2
IntermediaryAgent2.definition: Agent between the debtor's agent and the creditor's agent.||Usage: If more than two intermediary agents are present, then IntermediaryAgent2 identifies the agent between the IntermediaryAgent1 and the IntermediaryAgent3.

IntermediaryAgent2Account.name: Intermediary Agent 2 Account
IntermediaryAgent2Account.definition: Unambiguous identification of the account of the intermediary agent 2 at its servicing agent in the payment chain.

IntermediaryAgent3.name: Intermediary Agent 3
IntermediaryAgent3.definition: Agent between the debtor's agent and the creditor's agent.||Usage: If IntermediaryAgent3 is present, then it identifies the agent between the IntermediaryAgent 2 and the CreditorAgent.

IntermediaryAgent3Account.name: Intermediary Agent 3 Account
IntermediaryAgent3Account.definition: Unambiguous identification of the account of the intermediary agent 3 at its servicing agent in the payment chain.

UltimateDebtor.name: Ultimate Debtor
UltimateDebtor.definition: Ultimate financial institution that owes an amount of money to the (ultimate) institutional creditor.

Debtor.name: Debtor
Debtor.definition: Financial institution that owes an amount of money to the (ultimate) financial institutional creditor.

DebtorAccount.name: Debtor Account
DebtorAccount.definition: Unambiguous identification of the account of the debtor to which a debit entry will be made as a result of the transaction.

DebtorAgent.name: Debtor Agent
DebtorAgent.definition: Financial institution servicing an account for the debtor.

DebtorAgentAccount.name: Debtor Agent Account
DebtorAgentAccount.definition: Unambiguous identification of the account of the debtor agent at its servicing agent in the payment chain.

CreditorAgent.name: Creditor Agent
CreditorAgent.definition: Financial institution servicing an account for the creditor.

CreditorAgentAccount.name: Creditor Agent Account
CreditorAgentAccount.definition: Unambiguous identification of the account of the creditor agent at its servicing agent to which a credit entry will be made as a result of the payment transaction.

Creditor.name: Creditor
Creditor.definition: Financial institution that receives an amount of money from the financial institutional debtor.

CreditorAccount.name: Creditor Account
CreditorAccount.definition: Unambiguous identification of the account of the creditor to which a credit entry will be posted as a result of the payment transaction.

UltimateCreditor.name: Ultimate Creditor
UltimateCreditor.definition: Ultimate financial institution to which an amount of money is due.

InstructionForCreditorAgent.name: Instruction For Creditor Agent
InstructionForCreditorAgent.definition: Further information related to the processing of the payment instruction, provided by the initiating party, and intended for the creditor agent.

InstructionForNextAgent.name: Instruction For Next Agent
InstructionForNextAgent.definition: Further information related to the processing of the payment instruction that may need to be acted upon by the next agent. ||Usage: The next agent may not be the creditor agent.|The instruction can relate to a level of service, can be an instruction that has to be executed by the agent, or can be information required by the next agent.

Purpose.name: Purpose
Purpose.definition: Underlying reason for the payment transaction.|Usage: Purpose is used by the end-customers, that is initiating party, (ultimate) debtor, (ultimate) creditor to provide information concerning the nature of the payment. Purpose is a content element, which is not used for processing by any of the agents involved in the payment chain.

RegulatoryReporting.name: Regulatory Reporting
RegulatoryReporting.definition: Information needed due to regulatory and statutory requirements.

RemittanceInformation.name: Remittance Information
RemittanceInformation.definition: Information supplied to enable the matching of an entry with the items that the transfer is intended to settle, such as commercial invoices in an accounts' receivable system.

UnderlyingAllocation.name: Underlying Allocation
UnderlyingAllocation.definition: Provides information on the underlying allocations that make up the payment.||Usage: Only used by the Securities industry.

UltimateDebtorGuideline.definition: UltimateDebtor may only be present if different from Debtor.

UltimateCreditorGuideline.definition: UltimateCreditor may only be present if different from Creditor.

IntermediaryAgent2Rule.definition: If IntermediaryAgent2 is present, then IntermediaryAgent1 must be present.

IntermediaryAgent3Rule.definition: If IntermediaryAgent3 is present, then IntermediaryAgent2 must be present.

IntermediaryAgent1Rule.definition: If IntermediaryAgent1 is present, then CreditorAgent must be present.

IntermediaryAgent1AccountRule.definition: If IntermediaryAgent1Account is present, then IntermediaryAgent1 must be present.

IntermediaryAgent2AccountRule.definition: If IntermediaryAgent2Account is present, then IntermediaryAgent2 must be present.

IntermediaryAgent3AccountRule.definition: If IntermediaryAgent3Account is present, then IntermediaryAgent3 must be present.

DebtorAgentAccountRule.definition: If DebtorAgentAccount is present, then DebtorAgent must be present.

CreditorAgentAccountRule.definition: If CreditorAgentAccount is present, then CreditorAgent must be present.

PreviousInstructingAgent1AccountRule.definition: If PreviousInstructingAgent1Account is present, then PreviousInstructingAgent1 must be present.

PreviousInstructingAgent2AccountRule.definition: If PreviousInstructingAgent2Account is present, then PreviousInstructingAgent2 must be present.

PreviousInstructingAgent3AccountRule.definition: If PreviousInstructingAgent3Account is present, then PreviousInstructingAgent3 must be present.

PreviousInstructingAgent2Rule.definition: If PreviousInstructingAgent2 is present, then PreviousInstructingAgent1 must be present.

PreviousInstructingAgent3Rule.definition: If PreviousInstructingAgent3 is present, then PreviousInstructingAgent2 must be present.

PreviousInstructingAgent1Guideline.definition: It is recommended that, when present, PreviousInstructingAgent1 is the closest to the DebtorAgent in the payment chain.
